pages.text: Wolves and horses wear $(item)Barding$(). Its star comes from its parts.$(li)$(item)Leather$(): leather panels and straps.$(li)$(item)Mail$(): leather barding and chain links.$(li)$(item)Plate$(): mail barding and armor plates.$(br2)Right-click your wolf to put it on; a horse takes it in its armor slot. A wolf's barding takes its hits, like wolf armor.
pages.title: Barding

pages.text: Cats and parrots wear a $(item)Collar$() (straps and gold fittings): +1 max health per star, and +1 armor from four stars. Right-click your cat or parrot to put it on; sneak and right-click it with an empty hand to take it off.$(br2)Your Beastmastery sets the best star you can make: two to start, three at level 10, then one more every 10 levels.
pages.title: Collars
